text:
ammar: Quick sync on the ModelHub outage follow-ups. Root cause summary: cloud region AZ3 packet loss + modelhub auth endpoint misconfiguration caused fail-open retries that saturated our request fanout. We tracked three recurring patterns: 1) per-request auth lookups causing thundering herd, 2) service-level retries without backoff, 3) no local token fallback. Need owners + deadlines.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-401 logged: modelhub-az3-network -> cascading timeouts. Link to logs: /incidents/2026/401.

priya: From the PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-401, recommendation set: short-term circuit + rate-limit per-caller, medium-term signed local tokens via KMS, long-term vendor SLA + multi-region auth endpoints.

jake: I'll take the short-term circuit and retry backoff changes. Plan: implement per-route circuit breaker (threshold 10 errs/min) and exponential backoff on retries with capped jitter. I'll open PR tonight. ETA PR: 2026-04-02, staging deploy: 2026-04-03.

lydia: I'll own the token-fallback prototype. Idea: maintain a signed token cache rotated every 5m via KMS with narrow scopes. If modelhub returns 5xx or timeouts, accept cached token for up to 10m. Risks: revocation complexity. Draft design by 2026-04-07.

eamonn: I'll run vendor outreach and contract ask: request multi-AZ auth endpoints and an issuance SLA (99.9% per-minute). I'll coordinate with legal. Target: vendor meeting set by 2026-04-09 and negotiation points doc by 2026-04-15.

priya: For observability: add `modelhub.request.retry_rate` and `auth.cached_token_usage` metrics, and a dashboard tile in Console titled "ModelHub Resilience". ETA: dashboard + alert thresholds by 2026-04-05.

jake: Short mitigation snippet for ops: 
```
# pseudo: per-request guard
if endpoint_in_az3 and error_rate > 10/min:
  open_circuit(route)
  return 503_with_runbook_link()
else:
  normal_path()
```
I'll include an automated rollback if latency rises.

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued: jake/circuit-and-backoff -> tests pending.

ammar: Confirm owners and add to Postmortem "Follow-ups" section. Summary checklist: 
- Circuit breaker + retry backoff: jake (PR 4/02, staging 4/03)
- Signed local tokens (KMS): lydia (design 4/07)
- Vendor multi-AZ auth + SLA: eamonn (vendor mtg 4/09)
- Dashboards + alerts: priya (4/05)
- Ops playbook update + synthetic check: oncall rotation + priya (add synthetic check hitting auth endpoints 1/min) -> 4/05

lydia: Agree on acceptance criteria for local tokens: must pass cross-service compatibility test, automatic rotation, and audit logs. I'll include test matrix in design doc.

jake: Also proposing a weekly dependency-resilience review for the top-5 external services. Assign to platform-reliability. Priya, can you add to the roadmap?

priya: Will add and create a recurring calendar invite (quarterly reviews for vendors, weekly for first month post-change).

eamonn: Note: vendor is open to a private auth endpoint for customers on dedicated plans. We should evaluate cost/ops tradeoffs. Add to tradeoff doc.

ammar: Timeline check: we'll reconvene in 5 business days for a status check: 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. If PRs or blockers appear, post here. Thanks all. :shipit:
